purpose: Evidence packet only. The Emirates facts separate ordinary pet dogs from falcons and assistance dogs, which are different products and exceptions.

provenance_defaults.reviewer: Codex — lecture directe de la page officielle

facts.condition_scope: ordinary pets; falcons on certain Dubai-Pakistan routes and service dogs are separate exception flows
facts.finder_effect: For an ordinary pet dog, show cabin not offered rather than unknown.
facts.quote: Pets are not permitted in the cabin, with the exception of falcons between Dubai and certain destinations in Pakistan.
facts.locator: Unusual baggage and special allowances → Pets

facts.condition_scope: excess-baggage pet transport in a special hold area; documents, animal plus cage size/weight, route and journey-duration restrictions apply
facts.finder_effect: Show passenger-hold offered under conditions, never a claim of flight capacity or final acceptance.
facts.quote: You can pay for pets to travel as excess baggage on Emirates and they will be carried in a special area of the aircraft hold.

facts.condition_scope: pet carrier total dimensions length plus width plus height over 300 cm; other legal or route requirements may also require cargo
facts.finder_effect: Route a case above the carrier-dimension limit to cargo; do not infer a dog-only kilogram threshold.
facts.quote: If the total dimensions (length + width + height) of your pet carrier exceeds 300cm (118 in), your pet must be transported as cargo on your flight.
